title: Registry Page Options Schema
description: Generates a routed page (*.page.ts) under src/app/pages.

name.description: The name for the new page.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the page?

project.description: The name of the project where the page should be added.

path.description: The path where the page files should be created, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to src/app/pages.

skipTests.description: Skip the generation of unit test files `spec.ts`.
